latest_release.name: v3.1.3
latest_release.body:
All the terraform actions in this repository are released as one.
Use the actions as part of a GitHub Actions workflow, e.g:

```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - uses: dflook/terraform-plan@v3.1.3
      with:
        path: my-terraform-config
```

You can specify an action version as:
- `@v3.1.3` to use exactly this release
- `@v3.1` to use the latest patch release for this specific minor version
- `@v3` to use the latest patch release for this specific major version

## Changes

### Security
- The debug log no longer includes every environment variable. Only the default environment variables set by the actions runner are logged, e.g. GITHUB_REPOSITORY and RUNNER_OS.

  GitHub hides the debug log unless debug logging is enabled and masks known secrets, but self-hosted or third-party runners that capture the raw output of the action without masking could have shown the values of environment variables containing secrets, such as TERRAFORM_CLOUD_TOKENS.

    Thanks to [bamarch](https://github.com/bamarch) for reporting this issue.
